items.title: Laurena Diggs and Carrie Boote Interview, 1960-09-03
items.q: I didn't know him, you know, just personally to go about with him, but I knew of him because I'd been in company with him, you know, quite often.

ctx.x: Might be the same guy with two names, too. You know, that happens, too.

No, well, he was a great musician and he went over there and he never did come back. He used to play with Tate. During the time, Lewis was playing with Tate. Well, that's the same guy. Yeah. Uh-huh. He married an Indian princess? I read that into Ebony since I was here. He had passed about... It must have been between 56 because since I've been here, I read about him passed. Did you know him well? Not too well. You know how you come in contact with people, but I didn't know him, you know, just personally to go…
Well, who was this guy? Jill Pruset or Gil or something? Pruset? I couldn't understand it on the tape. Uh... I think he was... Joe Pruset? Oh, that must be Joe Pruset.
